articles.title: Tesla Sales Jumped in First Quarter, Rebounding From Last Year’s Slump
articles.mainIdea: Tesla Sales Jumped in First Quarter, Rebounding From Last Year’s Slump
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Tesla Sales Jumped in First Quarter, Rebounding From Last Year’s Slump. Tesla sales were up 6.3% in the first quarter compared with a year prior, but the company missed Wall Street estimates for deliveries. Related tickers mentioned: GM, TSLA.

articles.title: Ford Q1 U.S. sales down by 8.8%, but it says F-Series still top-seller
articles.mainIdea: Ford Q1 U.S. sales down by 8.8%, but it says F-Series still top-seller
articles.summary: Detroit Free Press: Ford Q1 U.S. sales down by 8.8%, but it says F-Series still top-seller. Ford reported a quarterly sales decline based on its shift away from smaller SUVs to larger ones, as well as inventory constraints. Related tickers mentioned: ALI=F.
